## Topics

- Hypothesis testing in R: t.test(), prop.test(), chisq.test()
- Linear regression with lm(): formulas, coefficients, and R-squared
- Logistic regression with glm(family = binomial): Odds Ratios and 95% CIs
- Tidy model summaries with broom (tidy(), glance(), augment())
- Formatting regression tables for publication
